nafc084e200.headline: 2024 Economic Review
nafc084e200.summary: Barbados recorded 4% real economic growth in 2024, its third consecutive year of growth. Visitor arrivals rose 10.7% from 2023, driving tourism performance.
nafc084e200.why: Tourism is a core driver of Barbados's economy, so visitor arrivals and growth figures inform views on the island's fiscal and debt outlook.

ncfc426a05f.headline: Marked upswing for take-home pay in 2024
ncfc426a05f.summary: BankservAfrica's Take-home Pay Index showed average nominal take-home pay up 11.9% year on year to R17,202 in December 2024. The index tracks about 4 million salary earners.
ncfc426a05f.why: Household take-home pay influences consumer spending, which is a major driver of South Africa's economy.

nb99a389be2.headline: Reps won’t compromise on the scrutinization of 2025 budget proposal – Deputy spokesperson
nb99a389be2.summary: A deputy spokesperson for the House said lawmakers would not compromise on scrutiny of the 2025 budget proposal. He said some ministries and agencies made solid presentations while others fell short.
nb99a389be2.why: The national budget sets government spending and revenue targets, which shape Nigeria's fiscal outlook and borrowing needs.

n9175bdb1f9.headline: Nigeria Considers New Energy Subsidies In $15 Billion Investment Pitch - Bloomberg
n9175bdb1f9.summary: Nigeria is considering new energy subsidies as part of a $15 billion investment pitch, according to Bloomberg. Details of the proposed subsidies were not provided in the source description.
n9175bdb1f9.why: Energy subsidies affect fiscal spending and fuel pricing in Africa's largest oil producer, which matters for investors in its energy and currency markets.

nd5faa8e502.headline: Sensex, Nifty surge nearly 1% on buying in IT stocks, firm global cues   - OrissaPOST
nd5faa8e502.summary: Sensex and Nifty rose nearly 1% on buying in IT, capital goods and industrial stocks. The 30-share BSE Sensex settled up 631.55 points, or 0.83%, at 76,532.96.
nd5faa8e502.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indices of India's stock market, tracking the largest listed companies on the BSE and NSE.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

sources.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

nd5faa8e502.why_moved: Buying in IT, capital goods and industrial stocks lifted the indices, supported by a firm trend in global markets.

ne355fb69d8.headline: SA auto industry faces threat from shift towards imported vehicles
ne355fb69d8.summary: South Africa's auto industry faces a threat from a shift towards imported vehicles and the entry of Chinese brands. Toyota South Africa's CEO has urged the government to address structural issues in the sector.
ne355fb69d8.why: The automotive sector is a major source of manufacturing output and exports for South Africa. Import competition and structural costs affect local factories, suppliers and jobs.

nca1dbdd288.headline: FG's 10-Year Bond Surges With A 22.6% Yield
nca1dbdd288.summary: Nigeria's federal government 10-year bond is reported to carry a 22.6% yield. The News Chronicle report gave no further detail on the auction or market conditions.
nca1dbdd288.why: Government bond yields set the benchmark cost of sovereign borrowing and influence rates across Nigeria's financial system.

ncf724f37e8.headline: BBC World Service to cut 130 roles to save £6m in the next year
ncf724f37e8.summary: BBC World Service will cut a net 130 jobs, including in the UK, as it seeks to save £6m in the year ahead. The cuts are part of cost-saving measures at the broadcaster.
ncf724f37e8.why: The BBC is a publicly funded broadcaster, and its World Service budget is set by government funding and licence-fee-related decisions.

ndcc1873ac6.headline: Finance Minister highlights Cyprus’ economic growth in Athens event
ndcc1873ac6.summary: Cyprus Finance Minister Makis Keravnos cited 2,300 new company registrations and 12,000 employees relocated to Cyprus. He spoke at a business event in Athens aimed at Greek businesses.
ndcc1873ac6.why: Company registrations and relocations signal inflows of business activity and investment into Cyprus, a small financial-services economy in the eastern Mediterranean.

n418a50ad30.headline: Smaller Japanese companies unlikely to meet wage-increase target for 2025
n418a50ad30.summary: The Japanese Trade Union Confederation set spring wage-hike targets above 6% for smaller firms, which may be hard for them to meet this year.
n418a50ad30.why: Wage growth in Japan affects consumer spending, corporate margins and the Bank of Japan's assessment of inflation.

na9dacad3ff.headline: What do Rachel Reeves’ plans for growth mean for the economy?
na9dacad3ff.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves announced a package of policies to boost economic growth, and PA News explains what the measures mean in practice.
na9dacad3ff.why: The UK Chancellor sets fiscal and economic policy, so growth measures affect business investment, public finances and gilt markets.

n86343c49a6.headline: Fed likely to hold rates steady despite Trump call for cuts as it awaits tariff, immigration changes - The Boston Globe
n86343c49a6.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged at its two-day policy meeting ending Wednesday, despite President Trump's call for cuts. Tariff and immigration changes are pending.
n86343c49a6.why: The Federal Reserve sets the US benchmark interest rate, which influences borrowing costs, bond yields, equity valuations and the dollar across global markets.

n313fb1e7aa.headline: New "specials" in the budgetary system
n313fb1e7aa.summary: A draft emergency ordinance published by the Finance Ministry would exempt 32 people, civil servants, from the 2025 stability austerity measures. The draft is open for decisional transparency consultation.
n313fb1e7aa.why: Romania's budget deficit and public spending decisions affect its sovereign debt and investor confidence in the country's fiscal policy.

ndfae2360f7.headline: DeepSeek blocked on Apple, Google app stores in Italy
ndfae2360f7.summary: DeepSeek has been blocked on Apple and Google app stores in Italy. Ireland's data protection commission has also requested information from DeepSeek about data processing for Irish users.
ndfae2360f7.why: DeepSeek is a Chinese artificial intelligence developer, and regulatory action over data handling can limit its growth in Europe.

n4e764553f7.headline: Uber-backed Moove acquires Brazil’s Kovi to continue global expansion
n4e764553f7.summary: Uber-backed mobility-fintech Moove has acquired Kovi, a Brazilian car rental startup. Brazil is Latin America's largest ride-hailing market.
n4e764553f7.why: Moove is a fleet and mobility-finance company backed by Uber, and acquisitions like this extend its geographic reach in ride-hailing and vehicle leasing.

n3a67742012.headline: Central Bank of Ireland approves LemFi acquisition of Irish Fintech, Bureau Buttercrane
n3a67742012.summary: The Central Bank of Ireland approved LemFi's acquisition of Irish fintech Bureau Buttercrane. LemFi is a London-based startup offering international payments for immigrant communities.
n3a67742012.why: Cross-border payments and fintech firms are regulated by financial supervisors, and acquisitions in this sector depend on regulatory approval.

n3c9b3ec263.headline: Fed Hold Rates Steady, Says Job Market Is ‘Solid’
n3c9b3ec263.summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged after three cuts in a row last year. The central bank is taking a more cautious approach while it gauges where inflation is headed.
n3c9b3ec263.why: The Federal Reserve sets US benchmark interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, bond yields and equity valuations worldwide.

n42351722e4.headline: Third runway at Heathrow
n42351722e4.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves set out economic ambitions in a major speech that included government backing for a third runway at Heathrow. Critics said the package offered nothing for Scotland.
n42351722e4.why: Heathrow is the UK's largest airport, and runway capacity decisions shape airline investment, airport operator returns and regional connectivity.

n7f558d8471.headline: Deadline needed to end foreign exchange shortages in PNG
n7f558d8471.summary: Thomas Wangi says a deadline is needed to end foreign exchange rationing and restore kina convertibility in Papua New Guinea.
n7f558d8471.why: Foreign exchange rationing restricts businesses' access to dollars for imports, and kina convertibility affects the currency's value and trade.

source.name: Devpolicy Blog from the Development Policy Centre

sources.name: Devpolicy Blog from the Development Policy Centre

nec17423656.headline: MBRSC signs MoU with SpaceData to advance digital twin technology for UAE’s space and economic initiatives
nec17423656.summary: Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre has signed a memorandum of understanding with SpaceData, a Tokyo-based startup doing R&D on digital twin technology for space and economic initiatives.
nec17423656.why: Space agencies and space-technology partnerships shape demand for satellite data and digital tools, a growing commercial sector.

nd5096d5260.headline: We'll address your concerns, FG assures investors
nd5096d5260.summary: The Federal Government has assured investors that it will provide a stable business environment to promote business predictability. The statement was reported by Tribune Online.
nd5096d5260.why: Policy predictability and regulatory stability shape foreign and domestic investment decisions in Nigeria's economy.

ndabfd3d6c7.headline: Belief firms in rate relief as inflation takes breather
ndabfd3d6c7.summary: Markets and economists widely expect a February interest rate cut in Australia after underlying inflation came in below expectations, according to a regional report.
ndabfd3d6c7.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which influences borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and bond yields across the economy.

n7dd654c3c4.headline: Card-only policies discriminate against pensioners using cash, MEP claims - National News - Roscommon Herald
n7dd654c3c4.summary: Irish MEP Cynthia Ní Mhurchú said she will support amendments to new EU laws that would stop businesses from refusing cash payments.
n7dd654c3c4.why: EU consumer and payment rules determine whether businesses must accept cash, which affects payment providers and retailers.

n237292023b.headline: Card-only policies discriminate against pensioners using cash, MEP claims
n237292023b.summary: MEP Cynthia Ní Mhurchú says she will support amendments to new EU laws that would stop businesses from refusing cash, citing pensioners who rely on it.
n237292023b.why: EU payment rules govern how businesses must accept money, affecting payment processors, card networks and retailers across the bloc.

n0a88369b30.headline: United Utilities to hike dividends to shareholders amid bill increases for Cumbrians
n0a88369b30.summary: Water company United Utilities said it will raise dividends to shareholders while confirming consumer bill increases of 32 over the coming five years.
n0a88369b30.why: United Utilities is a major UK water company whose returns are set by regulated pricing and investment plans.

ne4911ba56f.headline: BBC axing another 130 jobs despite funding boost in October
ne4911ba56f.summary: The BBC is axing another 130 jobs despite a funding boost in October. It follows the announcement that a long-running show would end in March this year.
ne4911ba56f.why: The BBC is the UK's public broadcaster, funded mainly by the licence fee, and its cost decisions affect the UK media and production sector.

n035f2a8f35.headline: LKS, Antares Legal act on acquisition of Oremus Corp by Fornax
n035f2a8f35.summary: The shareholders of Oremus Corporate Services Private Limited are exiting as the company is set to be acquired by Fornax Corporate Services. LKS and Antares Legal advised on the deal.
n035f2a8f35.why: Corporate services firms in India handle company secretarial and compliance work, and their consolidation reflects demand for these services.

source.name: Bar and Bench - Indian Legal news

sources.name: Bar and Bench - Indian Legal news

ne416afc006.headline: Alibaba releases AI model it claims surpasses DeepSeek-V3
ne416afc006.summary: Alibaba released a new version of its Qwen 2.5 artificial intelligence model on Wednesday. The company claimed it surpassed the highly regarded DeepSeek-V3 model.
ne416afc006.why: Alibaba is a Chinese e-commerce and cloud group that is investing heavily in AI models. Competitive model releases influence cloud demand and the AI competition among Chinese tech firms.

n9bfdc7953c.headline: Trump slams Fed after decision to hold interest rates steady
n9bfdc7953c.summary: Federal Reserve policymakers left their benchmark rate unchanged as the economy appears to be humming along, despite the president's pressure for cuts.
n9bfdc7953c.why: The Federal Reserve sets US benchmark interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, bond yields and asset valuations across markets.
n9bfdc7953c.why_moved: The Fed held rates steady amid signs of solid economic growth, while the president publicly pressed for lower rates, keeping rate expectations in focus.

nd2262d8ebc.headline: Growth engine or casino? Global investors rethink China playbook
nd2262d8ebc.summary: Investor uncertainty and policy shifts have fundamentally changed how analysts and money managers view China's markets, prompting a rethink of the investment approach.
nd2262d8ebc.why: China is one of the world's largest economies and stock markets, so shifts in investor views affect global portfolio allocations.

n2ef673f3e4.headline: Germany's budget committee wants to approve 3 billion euros for Ukraine, sources say
n2ef673f3e4.summary: Germany's budget committee has asked Finance Minister Joerg Kukies to approve an additional 3 billion euros in military aid for Ukraine, according to Reuters sources. The request was reported on Wednesday.
n2ef673f3e4.why: Germany is one of Europe's largest economies and a major donor to Ukraine, so its fiscal decisions affect public spending and European defence budgets. Budget committee approvals govern how federal funds are released.

nc5daeedc7c.headline: Export sector posts strong start to 2025
nc5daeedc7c.summary: Vietnam's export sector is expected to remain a driving force for growth in 2025, after record export turnover of over US$405bn in 2024.
nc5daeedc7c.why: Exports are a major driver of Vietnam's economy, which is closely tied to global manufacturing supply chains.

n7d500cb751.headline: Germany sees 2025 export decline amid trade tensions
n7d500cb751.summary: European governments and companies are on alert for possible new US tariffs under President Donald Trump, while Germany sees a 2025 export decline.
n7d500cb751.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy and a major exporter, so its trade performance is closely watched by investors.

n973607aef5.headline: China’s export ban on engineers and equipment disrupts manufacturing overseas
n973607aef5.summary: Apple supplier Foxconn's factories in India have been waiting since January for technicians and machinery from China that have not arrived. The disruption stems from China's export ban on engineers and equipment.
n973607aef5.why: Apple depends on Foxconn for much of its iPhone assembly, so supply disruptions in India and China feed into the tech sector's production and earnings.

nacc0e9ab11.headline: Stocks lose 1,490 points on panic-selling
nacc0e9ab11.summary: The Karachi stock market lost 1,490 points on panic selling, despite an ample flow of positive economic data including a sixth straight cut in the interest rate.
nacc0e9ab11.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, so its moves reflect investor sentiment toward Pakistani equities and the economy.
nacc0e9ab11.why_moved: Panic selling drove the decline, according to the report, even though economic data included a sixth straight interest rate cut.

n618ef03e6c.headline: US intends to invest billions of dollars in Pakistan
n618ef03e6c.summary: The United States intends to invest billions of dollars in Pakistan across sectors including minerals, real estate and energy, according to a report from Islamabad.
n618ef03e6c.why: Foreign direct investment in minerals and energy can affect Pakistan's external financing and the scope for future projects.

n398a834fe3.headline: Eby says tariffs could hit B.C. harder than 2008 crisis, backs pandemic-style relief
n398a834fe3.summary: Premier David Eby said projections show U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods could hurt British Columbia's economy more than the 2008 recession, and he backed pandemic-style relief.
n398a834fe3.why: British Columbia's economy relies heavily on trade, including exports to the United States, so tariffs on Canadian goods directly affect provincial business activity.

n282aba3003.headline: Ministry proposes piloting a cryptocurrency exchange at financial centres
n282aba3003.summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Planning and Investment has proposed a controlled testing policy (sandbox) for fintech business models, including cryptocurrency exchanges.
n282aba3003.why: This initiative aims to develop Vietnam’s financial sector and attract foreign investment in fintech and digital assets.

n64d1d2d16f.headline: IATA's full 2024 data shows African carriers record 8.5% growth
n64d1d2d16f.summary: IATA reports 8.5% growth in African carriers' air cargo in 2024, supporting regional trade and connectivity.
n64d1d2d16f.why: Airline growth impacts regional trade, economic activity, and infrastructure development.

n6ded784966.headline: Vietnam establishes investment support fund to attract more major tech investors
n6ded784966.summary: Vietnam plans to attract foreign direct investment through a new fund offering incentives to large tech firms.
n6ded784966.why: The fund aims to boost Vietnam's technology sector and attract major international investors.

n90f75d5d77.headline: Crude Oil: Brent Continues to Struggle as Technicals Offer Bulls Hope
n90f75d5d77.summary: Brent crude oil prices continue to face downward pressure, although technical analysis suggests some potential support for bulls.
n90f75d5d77.why: Brent crude is a global oil benchmark influencing energy markets, inflation, and economic activity worldwide.
n90f75d5d77.why_moved: Technical factors are causing Brent crude prices to struggle despite some bullish support.
